deliveryFramework.headline: Sketch · Pilot · Scale
deliveryFramework.intro: The fastest way to move from idea to impact without drowning in docs.

steps.title: Sketch
steps.description: Co-create a lightweight storyboard everyone signs off on.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.description: Launch one high-impact flow and gather live feedback.

steps.title: Scale
steps.description: Train your team, add flows, and keep improving.

items.question: Do you build physical robots?
items.answer: No—everything we deliver is software-based automation across your existing tools.

items.question: How long to launch?
items.answer: Most engagements ship a production-ready pilot within 4–6 weeks.

items.question: How do you measure success?

items.question: Do you build physical robots?

deliveryFramework.headline: Sketch · Pilot · Scale
deliveryFramework.intro: The fastest way to move from idea to impact without drowning in docs.

steps.title: Sketch
steps.description: Co-create a lightweight storyboard everyone signs off on.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.description: Launch one high-impact flow and gather live feedback.

steps.title: Scale
steps.description: Train your team, add flows, and keep improving.

items.question: Will the bot replace my team?
items.answer: It reduces repetitive work and escalates to humans for edge cases—your team stays in control.

items.question: Can it integrate with my CRM?
items.answer: Yes—HubSpot, HighLevel, Sheets, and custom APIs are common.

items.question: How do you prevent hallucinations?

items.question: Do you build physical robots?
items.answer: No—everything we deliver is software-based automation across your existing tools.

items.question: How long to launch?

items.question: Do you build physical robots?
items.answer: No—everything we deliver is software-based automation across your existing tools.

items.question: How long to launch?

items.question: How do you measure success?

deliveryFramework.headline: Sketch · Pilot · Scale
deliveryFramework.intro: The fastest way to move from idea to impact without drowning in docs.

steps.title: Sketch
steps.description: Co-create a lightweight storyboard everyone signs off on.

steps.title: Pilot
steps.description: Launch one high-impact flow and gather live feedback.

steps.title: Scale
steps.description: Train your team, add flows, and keep improving.

items.question: Do you build physical robots?
items.answer: No—everything we deliver is software-based automation across your existing tools.

items.question: How long to launch?
items.answer: Most engagements ship a production-ready pilot within 4–6 weeks.

items.question: How do you measure success?
